entities.summary: Eric Isaiah Mobley is a Bahamian–American professional basketball player for Hapoel Jerusalem of the Ligat HaAl and the EuroCup. He played college basketball for the USC Trojans. He attended Rancho Christian School in Temecula, California, where he was a five-star recruit and McDonald's All-American. He was named first-team All-Pac-12 as a junior with USC.
